scaffold_to_remove: The current cut-aware score explicitly uses manually labelled L/R target components, anchor_side, and an opposite-component lookup.
descaffolded_objective: For each candidate equality, simulate only that candidate edge on the current equality-component partition, then compute the minimum structural distance between the components containing the two raw unresolved goal endpoints. Use no target-subterm basis, no L/R labels, no anchor-side label, and no manually selected opposite component.
frozen_candidate_pool: Exactly the same 35 replay-valid direct source-law instances from methodology-0036-cut-ranking-tournament-v1.

arms.A_LABELLED_CUT: the parent cut-aware ranking by predicted opposite-labelled-component distance
arms.B_RAW_GOAL_GRAPH: rank by counterfactual post-action separation of the two raw unresolved goal endpoints in the equality graph

measurements: top-k selection overlap between A and B

decision_table.DESCAFFOLD_SUCCESS: B contracts at K=1, is no worse than A at every preregistered prefix, and never uses privileged component-side metadata.
decision_table.DESCAFFOLD_DIFFERENT_BUT_USEFUL: B contracts by K<=4 but is weaker than A on at least one preregistered prefix.
decision_table.SCAFFOLD_DEPENDENT: A contracts at K=1 but B does not contract by K=4.
decision_table.MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: the frozen 35-candidate pool, 15 contractors, cut 10, component sizes 4/19, cap 19, or 9 reentry edges cannot be reproduced.

next_if_success: RECURSE dynamically: after each selected source instance, recompute the raw-goal component separation, rebuild the same lawful candidate family from the changed graph state, and select the next minimum-separation move. Compare against a cut-blind dynamic controller before transfer.
